title: Product Manager
description:
At ARIS, we’re on a mission to make construction simple, reliable and scalable — combining deep domain expertise with cutting\-edge technology. This isn’t a marketplace or a layer on top of existing systems, we’re building the underlying technology that powers logistics, credit decisions, and compliance at scale.
 



  





 Our platform runs live operations across 900\+ pin codes and supports real\-time tracking, automated documentation, and financial decisioning across a large supply chain. Performance, reliability, and correctness matter here.
 



  





 We believe that technology and product are two sides of the same coin: precision in code and empathy for the end user.
 



  





**Role Description:** 




 We are seeking a skilled Product Manager to join our dynamic tech and product team. As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for leading the development and execution of our product roadmap. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to define product requirements, prioritize features, and ensure the timely delivery of high\-quality products. This role requires a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of technology and a proven track record of successfully managing products from ideation to launch.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




 As a Product Manager, you will:
 



  




* Develop and maintain the product roadmap aligned with business goals and customer needs.
* Gather and prioritize product requirements from stakeholders, customers, and market research.
* Work closely with engineering, design, marketing, and sales teams to deliver products that meet market demands.
* Define product vision, strategy, and go\-to\-market plans.
* Conduct competitive analysis and market research to inform product decisions.
* Monitor and analyze product performance metrics, and make data\-driven decisions.
* Drive product launches including working with marketing, executives, and other product management team members.
* Act as a product evangelist to build awareness and understanding internally and externally.
* Proactively identify and resolve issues that may impair the team's ability to meet strategic, financial, and technical goals.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 2 to 6 years of experience as a Product Manager or in a similar role, preferably in a tech\-driven environment.
* Proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to executive leadership.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, agile environment and manage multiple competing priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field (MBA preferred)

title: Sr. Product Manager - Master Data Management
description:
**Sr. Product Manager – Master Data Management**
 Ingram Micro is looking for an experienced Sr. Product Manager to drive the roadmap and execution of key master data initiatives that shape the foundation of how our business operates. This is an important role in Ingram Micro's company\-wide master data transformation journey — helping build the data structures, governance frameworks, and product experiences that power trusted, consistent, and scalable data across the enterprise.
   

  

 The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to shape and deliver a product roadmap for their domain, prioritize initiatives informed by data, and drive execution in partnership with data engineering, enterprise architecture, and business operations stakeholders.
   

  

**You Will:**
* Drive the product roadmap and execution for one or more master data domains by deeply understanding business needs, data quality challenges, and the evolving enterprise data landscape.
* Advance a unified approach to master data — including product, customer, vendor, and financial data domains — ensuring consistency, accuracy, and accessibility across the organization.
* Design and improve data governance processes, data stewardship workflows, and master data lifecycle management experiences that empower business users and reduce friction.
* Collaborate with Experience Design, Engineering, Analytics, Data Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, and Business Operations teams to define, develop, and launch master data solutions and capabilities.
* Drive automation and continuous improvement to eliminate data quality issues, reduce manual data handling, and deliver measurable business outcomes such as time savings, cost reduction, and improved decision\-making.
* Partner with data and analytics teams to understand how master data flows across systems, identify gaps, and lead initiatives that improve data reliability and trustworthiness across the enterprise.
* Monitor and analyze the health and adoption of master data products, using insights to inform the ongoing transformation roadmap.


**You Have:**
* 5–8 years of experience in product management, with a strong preference for experience in data, platform, or enterprise product domains.
* 3\+ years of experience building products or platforms for B2B environments, ideally with exposure to data management, ERP systems, or enterprise data platforms.
* Experience working with cross\-functional go\-to\-market and operations teams to drive adoption of internal data products and capabilities across business units.
* Familiarity with master data management (MDM) concepts, data governance frameworks, and data quality principles strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of analytics tools such as Looker or Adobe Analytics, as well as data pipeline or integration concepts, preferred.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from complex data sets and translate them into actionable product decisions.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills and the ability to influence stakeholders across technical and business teams.

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
**About Us** 




 We are surrounded by the world's leading consumer companies led by technology \- Amazon for retail, Airbnb for hospitality, Uber for mobility, Netflix and Spotify for entertainment, etc. Food \& Beverage is the only consumer sector where large players are still traditional restaurant companies. At Rebel Foods, we are challenging this status quo as we are building the world's most valuable restaurant company on the internet, superfast.
 



 The opportunity for us is immense due to the exponential growth in the food delivery business worldwide which has helped us build 'The World's Largest Internet Restaurant Company' in the last few years. Rebel Foods' current presence in India \& UAE with close to 50 brands and 4500\+ internet restaurants has been built on The Rebel Operating System.
 



 While for us it is still Day 1, we know we are in the middle of a revolution towards creating never seen before customer\-first experiences. We bring you a once\-in\-a\-lifetime opportunity to disrupt the 500\-year\-old industry with technology at its core.
 



 We urge you to refer to the below to understand how we are changing the restaurant industry before applying at Rebel Foods.
 



 https://spirit.rebelfoods.com/why\-is\-rebel\-foods\-hiring\-super\-talented\-engineers\-b88586223ebe
 



 https://spirit.rebelfoods.com/how\-to\-build\-1000\-restaurants\-in\-24\-months\-the\-rebel\-method\-cb5b0cea4dc8
 



 https://spirit.rebelfoods.com/winning\-the\-last\-frontier\-for\-consumer\-internet\-5f2a659c43db
 



 https://spirit.rebelfoods.com/a\-unique\-take\-on\-food\-tech\-dcef8c51ba41
 



  





**About the role** 




 Rebel's owned channels are at the heart of our consumer business. They comprise the EatSure app \- our flagship channel, individual brand apps, subscription\-based order channels, international products and emerging experiences like offline ordering.
 



 As Principal Product Manager \- Own Channels, you will define the product strategy that drives their growth. You'll own the roadmap, lead Product and Design teams, and partner closely with business leadership to shape business outcomes, not just product / tech outputs.
 



 Success in this role is measured by outcomes: improving conversion, building exceptional customer experiences, increasing AOV and cross\-brand ordering, launching new growth businesses, and scaling Rebel's digital products across markets.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* Define the product vision and strategy for EatSure, brand apps, international products and new ordering channels.
* Co\-own business outcomes with leadership, translating growth priorities into product strategy and execution.
* Build and drive the product roadmap, balancing customer experience, business impact and long\-term platform investments.
* Lead and develop a team of Product Managers and Product Designers, raising the bar on product thinking, execution and craft.
* Create category\-leading ordering journeys that improve conversion, app ratings, retention and customer delight.
* Build new growth engines from AI\-powered experiences and brand\-first digital products to international expansion and offline ordering.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing and Operations to deliver products that customers love and businesses scale on.



  





**Who we're looking for** 




 We're looking for a product leader with strong product instincts and equally strong business judgment.
 



 You'll likely bring:
 


* 6\+ years of product management experience in leading consumer technology companies.
* A track record of building and scaling successful consumer products with measurable business impact.
* Experience defining product strategy, not just shipping features.
* Experience leading Product Managers and building high\-performing product teams.
* Excellent product thinking, analytical rigor and communication skills.
* A passion for building elegant customer experiences powered by data and AI.
* D2C, e\-commerce or marketplace experience is a strong advantage.



  





**How we work** 




 Product plays a central role in shaping Rebel's business. Our leaders have the autonomy to make consequential decisions, challenge conventional thinking and build products end\-to\-end.
 



 In return, we expect deep ownership. You'll be accountable for outcomes, not outputs; thinking like a business builder, obsessing over customer experience, and continuously raising the bar for product quality.
 



 If you're excited by high ownership, ambitious product problems and the opportunity to shape how millions of customers discover and order food, we'd love to talk.

title: India Field Crops Head
description:
**Company Description**
 Syngenta Seeds is one of the world’s largest developers and producers of seed for farmers, commercial growers, retailers and small seed companies. Syngenta seeds improve the quality and yields of crops. High\-quality seeds ensure better and more productive crops, which is why farmers invest in them. Advanced seeds help mitigate risks such as disease and drought and allow farmers to grow food using less land, less water and fewer inputs.
   

  

 Syngenta Seeds brings farmers more vigorous, stronger, resistant plants, including innovative hybrid varieties and biotech crops that can thrive even in challenging growing conditions.
   

  

 Syngenta Seeds is headquartered in the United States.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role purpose**
 Lead the India Field Crops Seeds business with full accountability for business performance, strategy execution and sustainable growth. Drive end\-to\-end value creation across portfolio, demand generation, commercial execution, supply alignment and talent development to strengthen Syngenta's market leadership in India.
   

  

 Shape and execute the long\-term growth strategy for the Field Crops business by integrating market insights, customer needs, innovation pipelines and operational excellence. Build a high\-performing organization that delivers superior commercial outcomes while fostering collaboration across Commercial, Marketing, Supply, Production \& Supply, R\&D, Finance and regional stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
**Business \& P\&L Leadership**
 Accountable for delivering the India Field Crops Seeds business strategy, revenue, market share, profitability and cash\-generation objectives. Drive sustainable business growth while ensuring strong financial discipline and resource optimization
   

  

**Strategic Growth \& Portfolio Management**
 Define and execute the medium and long\-term strategy for the India Field Crops business. Shape portfolio investment priorities, lifecycle management, innovation launches, germplasm deployment and growth opportunities that strengthen competitive advantage and customer value creation.
   

  

**Commercial Excellence \& Market Leadership**
 Lead commercial strategy and execution across pricing, demand generation, channel effectiveness, customer engagement and in\-season business performance management. Ensure superior execution and profitable market share growth across all Field Crops segments
   

  

**End\-to\-End Business Integration**
 Orchestrate alignment across Marketing, Supply Chain, Production \& Supply, R\&D, Finance and Sales teams to ensure effective planning, forecasting, inventory management and business delivery. Drive enterprise\-wide decision\-making that balances short\-term performance with long\-term value creation.
   

  

**Customer, Market \& Industry Stewardship**
 Develop deep understanding of the evolving agricultural landscape, customer needs, channel dynamics and competitive environment. Build strategic relationships with key customers, distributors, industry influencers and external stakeholders to strengthen Syngenta's leadership position.
   

  

**Innovation \& Transformation**
 Champion innovation, business model evolution and continuous improvement to accelerate growth and improve organizational effectiveness. Foster a culture that embraces change, drives operational excellence and leverages data\-driven decision making.
   

  

**Leadership \& Talent Development**
 Build, inspire and develop a high\-performing leadership team and talent pipeline for the future. Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, inclusion and performance excellence while strengthening succession readiness across the organization
   

  

**Stakeholder Management \& Enterprise Leadership**
 Influence and collaborate across country, regional and global leadership teams to secure alignment on strategic priorities and business decisions. Represent India Field Crops in key leadership forums and contribute to broader business and enterprise objectives
   

  

**Critical success factors \& key challenges**
* Strong end\-to\-end business leadership with full P\&L accountability.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with execution excellence.
* Deep customer and market orientation.
* Strong matrix leadership and stakeholder influencing capability.
* Proven track record of building high\-performing teams and future leaders.
* Enterprise mindset with the ability to drive growth across complex business ecosystems.

 Driving Results
   

  

* Drives towards top business performance. Pushes to meet or beat goals, and personally improves performance. At highest levels, changes what the organization or even the industry can do, creating far greater results.


 Strategic Thinking
   

  

* Focuses on larger, mid\-term issues, and creates plans and strategies. Develops a strategy that conceptualizes and incorporates complex market issues, and provides a clear concept for the future that people understand and which enables them to move forward.


 Collaborating and Influencing
   

  

* Engages with others over whom they have no authority. Creates partnerships. Collaborates to achieve results. At the highest levels, creates enduring partnerships across functions. This capability incorporates collaboration, influencing, and networking.


 Building People Capabilities
   

  

 Develops people over the long term. Identifies issues, gives feedback, and supports and enables development. Creates systematic development across commercial SE organization and through leadership of the seed CDG enables cross functional talent development.

title: Technical Manager - Zendesk ( 6 months contractual role)
description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a high\-impact Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead the strategy, evolution, and technical stability of our Customer Experience (CX) ecosystem. Having completed a migration from Salesforce to Zendesk Enterprise, we are now building a proactive, automated, high\-efficiency CRM.
   

  

 In this role, you will serve as the "Enterprise Systems \& AI Product Owner." You will lead a team of two Zendesk Specialists, collaborate directly with enterprise clients to scope API integrations, and drive cross\-functional engineering projects. You will be responsible for turning Zendesk into an AI\-enabled workspace—deploying Zendesk Copilot, AI Agents for deflection, Zendesk AutoQA, Zendesk WFM, Glean Enterprise Search, and Gemini LLM integrations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic AI Ecosystem \& Native Zendesk Optimization**
* Autonomous AI Deflection: Build, optimize, and oversee Zendesk AI Agents (Bots) to increase self\-service resolution rates for Tier\-1 inquiries.
* Agent Copilot \& Productivity: Architect and fine\-tune Zendesk Copilot (Auto\-Assist workflows, real\-time ticket summarization, and suggested next actions) to reduce Average Handle Time (AHT) and cognitive load.
* 100% Automated Quality Governance: Established Zendesk AutoQA scorecards and automated grading logic to continuously evaluate 100% of human and bot interactions, using sentiment analysis to flag churn risks and coaching opportunities.
* Workforce Management (WFM): Oversee Zendesk WFM (Tymeshift) configuration to transition from reactive staffing to data\-driven, predictive capacity planning.


**Platform Architecture \& Tool Integrations (Glean / Gemini)**
* Enterprise AI \& Search Readiness: Partner with engineering and data teams to connect enterprise search tools (Glean) directly into Zendesk so agents can search across Confluence, Drive, and internal tools from a single workspace.
* Gemini LLM Workflows: Build data pipelines and API hooks to connect Gemini/LLMs for predictive retention modeling, automated drafts, and custom object field enrichment.
* Internal Tool Middleware: Oversee integrations between Zendesk, internal ERPs, product databases, and middleware (e.g., Webhooks) to create a single 360\-degree CRM workspace.


**Customer API Discovery \& Developer Experience**
* External Client Solutions: Interface directly with strategic business clients and account executives to gather technical requirements for direct API access, custom webhooks, and dedicated customer portal integrations.
* Developer Experience: Partner with internal software engineers to maintain clean, secure, rate\-managed, and well\-documented Zendesk REST APIs for customer usage.


**Governance, Stability \& Knowledge Architecture**
* Environment Governance: Establish strict Sandbox\-to\-Production release pipelines, manage API rate limits, audit trigger loops, and ensure compliance (GDPR/Data Privacy).
* Knowledge Architecture (KCS): Lead a Knowledge\-Centered Service strategy to consolidate company\-wide documentation into a structured source of truth indexed within Zendesk.
* Team Leadership: Directly manage and mentor 2 Zendesk Specialists, managing sprint planning, task prioritization, and platform issue triage.


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years in Technical Program Management, Systems Engineering, or CX Platform Ownership.
* Zendesk Enterprise Mastery: Demonstrated expertise in architecting complex Zendesk instances, including Sandbox environments, Custom Objects, Omnichannel Routing, Copilot, AI Agents (Bots), AutoQA, and WFM.
* Integration \& API Technical Depth: Proven experience with REST APIs, Webhooks, JSON, OAuth, Postman, and middleware integration tools (Workato, Zapier, n8n).
* AI \& Search Engines: Hands\-on experience or technical project delivery involving Enterprise Search (e.g., Glean, Coveo) and LLMs (e.g., Google Gemini, OpenAI).
* Client Engagement: Ability to run discovery meetings directly with tech teams to translate business needs into clear technical specifications.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Zendesk Certified Systems Architect.
* Demonstrated track record implementing Knowledge\-Centered Service (KCS) principles across multi\-department teams.


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About Anthropic**
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre\-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia\-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer\-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.
   

  

 Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation
* Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams \& stakeholders to drive customer success
* Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work
* Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering \& development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives
* Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
* Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
* Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
* Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
* Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
* Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market


**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**
* 10\+ years of experience in technical customer\-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
* Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C\-suite executives, engineering \& IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross\-organizational collaboration, working through trade\-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross\-organizational collaboration, working through trade\-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team


**Logistics**
**Minimum education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
   

  

**Required field of study:** 
 A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
   

  

**Minimum years of experience:** 
 Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
   

  

**Location\-based hybrid policy:** 
 Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
   

  

**Visa sponsorship:** 
 We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
   

  

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** 
 Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
   

  

**Your safety matters to us.** 
 To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
   

  

**How We're Different**
 We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
   

  

 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
   

  

**Come work with us!**
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
 **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** 
 Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Principal Product Manager, Core Network
description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise\-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet\-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
 Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
   

  

****What you'll be responsible for****
 You will own the product strategy and evolution of the CPN Payments Engine — the core infrastructure that powers payment creation, routing, settlement, and lifecycle management across the network. You’ll define the long\-term vision and roadmap for the engine, identifying opportunities to expand its capabilities while improving reliability, performance, and scale. Working across Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and commercial teams, you’ll lead complex product decisions and investments that enable OFIs and BFIs to move money efficiently across an expanding set of corridors and rails, translating platform improvements into measurable network and business outcomes.
   

  

****What you'll work on****
* Set the Payments Engine strategy: Own the long\-term product vision and roadmap for payment creation, processing, routing, and settlement, aligning investments with CPN and Circle priorities.
* Advance payment performance at scale: Establish the product strategy for improving success rates, latency, resilience, and processing efficiency, using data to identify systemic opportunities and prioritize investments.
* Evolve API and protocol capabilities: Define the direction for OFI Payments APIs and BFI quoting and settlement protocols, balancing developer experience, interoperability, compliance, scalability, and network reliability.
* Expand the capabilities of the network: Identify and lead investments that unlock new payment use cases, corridors, rails, and partner capabilities while building reusable infrastructure that scales across the network.
* Shape observability and operational control: Define product capabilities for monitoring, alerting, exception management, and operational tooling that improve visibility into payment health and enable faster resolution of network issues.
* Lead complex cross\-functional decisions: Partner with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, BD, and other product leaders to navigate architectural and business trade\-offs, resolve ambiguity, and drive alignment on high\-impact investments.
* Establish product leadership for payment infrastructure: Develop frameworks, metrics, and product practices that improve decision\-making across CPN, mentor other product managers, and serve as a subject matter expert on payment infrastructure across Circle.


****What you'll bring to Circle****
****Core requirements****
* 10\+ years of relevant experience, including significant Product Management experience building payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure products.
* Deep experience owning platform or infrastructure products such as APIs, payment processing systems, settlement platforms, routing systems, or developer\-facing capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to define product strategy and lead highly complex initiatives spanning multiple engineering and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong analytical and technical fluency, with the ability to use payment performance, reliability, and operational data to identify systemic issues and guide product investment decisions.
* Track record of delivering measurable improvements to large\-scale systems, including reliability, success rates, latency, scalability, operational efficiency, or customer outcomes.
* Ability to evaluate complex technical and business trade\-offs and translate them into clear product decisions, priorities, and long\-term platform investments.
* Strong cross\-functional influence and communication skills, including the ability to build alignment with senior leaders and stakeholders across Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and commercial teams.


**Preferred Requirements**
* Deep knowledge of payment networks, cross\-border payments, settlement systems, correspondent banking, stablecoins, or blockchain\-based financial infrastructure.
* Experience with enterprise API products, two\-sided networks, and compliance\-forward payment systems, including concepts such as SLAs, payment lifecycle events, exception handling, sanctions screening, RFIs, or the Travel Rule.

title: Senior Manager, Product Management
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are looking for a Senior Manager, Product Management to join our team within our Clinicals division. In this role you will be responsible for one or more product areas within the overarching product’s portfolio; understanding the market and customers, contributing to the product vision, developing business cases and ensuring a set of product features meet business requirements. You will help define how AI is responsibly integrated into clinical workflows, ensuring solutions are safe, trustworthy, and deliver measurable value to healthcare providers and patients.
   

  

 You will work closely with scrum teams defining and writing user stories, prioritizing product backlogs, and making trade\-off decisions between scope and schedule. Your work will span both strengthening our current solutions and delivering innovative, AI\-driven features that improve user experience and clinical decision\-making. Success in this role will be measured by improvements in provider efficiency, mobile adoption, workflow completion, user satisfaction, product quality, and safe adoption of AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Mobile team brings together Product Management, Engineering, User Experience, Product Analytics, Data Science, and Patient Safety partners to improve the efficiency and experience of healthcare providers. The team works across product strategy, execution, and measurement to deliver both core product capabilities and AI\-enabled solutions where they add value. The team collaborates closely to ensure products are usable, reliable, and aligned with clinical and business needs. This role will support that mission by helping shape product decisions and delivery for an assigned area.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Drive product vision incorporating AI/ML capabilities, predictive insights, and automation opportunities
* Lead early\-stage discovery for features including: Identifying high\-value use cases for AI, Validating concepts with users and stakeholders, and Defining data requirements and feasibility
* Partner with UX, Analytics and Data Science teams to define measurement strategies for AI feature performance (e.g., validity, bias, data quality, adoption, impact)
* Translate product strategy into outcome\-based roadmaps that connect customer problems, business goals, delivery priorities, and measurable success criteria.
* Define product success metrics for each major initiative, including adoption, engagement, workflow efficiency, customer satisfaction, safety, and business impact.
* Own go\-to\-market strategies for products, including its AI\-enabled features
* Monitor post\-release performance and use product analytics, customer feedback, and operational data to guide iteration and prioritization.
* Work directly with scrum teams to prioritize work and ensure delivery of both core and AI\-enabled product capabilities
* Own ongoing maintenance of core products, including triaging production issues and managing enhancements
* Collaborate with data science and engineering teams to translate AI models into scalable product features
* Understand the market opportunity via user needs, market forces, applicable business models, emerging AI trends and competitive AI capabilities
* Drive the analysis of Product Area(s) of ownership including AI/ML\-driven products
* Define epics and user stories that clearly articulate: Functional requirements, User experience considerations, Data and model requirements, AI behavior expectations (e.g., explainability, confidence levels)
* Partner with UX and Engineering to design mobile experiences that are intuitive, accessible, performant, and reliable in fast\-moving clinical environments.
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering to manage the full AI/ML lifecycle, including model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s Degree required: Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, or related field preferred
* 6\+ years of product management experience
* Understanding of US healthcare / health IT environment is strongly preferred
* Experience working in an Agile environment is strongly preferred
* Experience building or scaling mobile products, preferably iOS and Android applications in SaaS, healthcare, or enterprise environments.
* Understanding of mobile UX patterns, performance considerations, accessibility, release management, and app adoption strategies.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and productization of AI features
* Familiarity with: Model lifecycle (training, validation, deployment, monitoring), Data pipelines and data quality considerations, Experimentation frameworks
* Understanding of Responsible AI principles, model bias, and explainability
* Experience working on AI\-driven or data\-intensive products preferred
* Experience bringing products to market is needed
* Technical understanding (mobile, SaaS, data, APIs) – ability to check technical feasibility and timelines and remove technical development barriers
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear business value

 At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.
   

  

**Overview Of Role**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and collaborative Associate Delivery Manager with a strong Agile and Scrum background to support the successful delivery of customer\-facing technology programs across cloud, data, AI, analytics, and application development initiatives.
   

  

 This role is ideal for professionals with approximately 3\+ years of experience who have worked as a Scrum Master, Project Coordinator, Agile Delivery Lead, Technical Project Coordinator, or Associate Project Manager and are looking to grow into broader Delivery Management responsibilities.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will play a key role in facilitating Agile delivery, coordinating cross\-functional teams, removing delivery impediments, and ensuring timely execution of project milestones. You will partner closely with Delivery Managers, Product Owners, Architects, Engineering teams, and customers to deliver high\-quality technology solutions while continuously improving Agile maturity and delivery excellence. In addition to supporting larger and more complex programs, you will also have the opportunity to independently manage smaller customer engagements as the Delivery Manager, taking ownership of planning, execution, stakeholder communication, and successful delivery.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Coordination**
* Support the successful delivery of software, cloud, data, AI, and application development projects.
* Coordinate sprint execution, release planning, project tracking, and delivery milestones.
* Assist Delivery Managers in monitoring project health, risks, dependencies, and delivery schedules.
* Track project progress, team capacity, resource allocation, and delivery metrics.
* Escalate delivery risks and blockers proactively while driving timely resolution.
* Ensure project documentation, governance artifacts, and status reports are maintained accurately.
* Support multiple concurrent Agile projects and distributed engineering teams.
* Independently manage smaller customer engagements as the Delivery Manager, owning end\-to\-end delivery including planning, execution, stakeholder communication, risk management, and successful project outcomes.

description:
*Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self\-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future.  Ares is seeking a highly motivated, detail\-oriented Associate Vice President to join the Fund Launch, Onboarding and Wind Down (“FLOW”) team and act as the business liaison to technology \[across multiple initiatives supporting the fund launch lifecycle for Private Credit, Real Estate, Private Equity, and Secondaries funds,]. In this role, the successful candidate will help bridge the gap between the business and technology by analyzing interconnected operational processes, documenting requirements, and supporting the full development lifecycle, including release testing and change management.

**Process Improvements**

* Collaborate with stakeholders across operational teams to understand workflows, identify team\-specific and intersectional opportunities for improvement, and translate requirements into development\-ready enhancements

**Qualifications\-**
 Education: BS/BA with degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or General Business preferred, with outstanding academic record
   

  

**Experience And Skills Required**

* Strong problem\-solver with ability to identify and resolve issues before they become issues
* Self\-motivated and able to operate independently, proactively seeking clarity in ambiguous situations
* Highly adaptable and able to pivot quickly in response to changing priorities
* Analytical thinker with proven history of surfacing actionable insights to inform prioritization of process and data improvements across systems and enhancement requests
* Highly adaptable and able to reassess and pivot in response to quickly changing priorities
* Familiar with Agile, Scrum or other iterative product management style

**Strongly Preferred**

title: Technical Product Manager AI
description:
**About Atlys** 




 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
 



 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
 



 Atlys is changing that.
 



 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We're looking for a
 **Technical Product Manager** 
 to drive the execution of complex technical initiatives across Engineering, Product, AI and Operations.
 



 You'll bring structure to ambiguity, align cross\-functional teams and ensure critical programs are delivered with speed, quality and measurable business impact.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who thrives in fast\-moving environments, enjoys solving complex execution challenges and can build scalable systems that enable Atlys to ship faster and operate more efficiently.
 



  





**The Job** 



* **Lead automation and AI/ML infrastructure** 
 pipelines, model serving and evaluation.
* **Own end\-to\-end execution** 
 across Engineering, Product, AI and Operations.
* **Translate technical and business needs** 
 , including AI constraints, into structured execution plans.
* **Track delivery through dashboards and AI metrics** 
 accuracy, latency and cost.
* **Drive cross\-functional alignment and responsible AI practices** 
 guardrails and human\-in\-the\-loop review.



  





**The Ideal Candidate** 




 You'll likely thrive in this role if you:
 


* 4–7 years as a TPM, Engineering PM, or similar execution\-focused role, ideally with AI/ML exposure.
* Led complex cross\-functional technical programs, including AI/ML teams.
* Highly structured and detail\-oriented, comfortable bringing clarity to ambiguity.
* Analytical and data\-driven, using metrics — including model accuracy and latency — to prioritise and improve execution.
* Communicates exceptionally well, influences without authority, across technical, business and AI/ML teams.



*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.* 




  





**What you can expect** 




 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
 



 Here’s what you can expect:
 


* **Competitive compensation and equity** 
 so you participate in the value you help create.
* **Comprehensive health insurance** 
 covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* **A thoughtful leave policy** 
 with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office** 
 , so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Learning \& development credits** 
 to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* **Relocation support** 
 to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* **Great tools to do your best work** 
 , including high\-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work** 
 , with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


- 


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
 



  





*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Senior Technical Specialist
description:
We are seeking a Senior Technical Specialist to join our Professional Services team supporting the implementation, configuration, and business analysis of our ConceptOne™ platform and advanced Identity \& Access Management solutions. This role is ideal for a technically strong professional with expertise in SQL development, system configuration, business requirements gathering, and analysis. You will possess deep insurance domain knowledge and the ability to work directly with project teams to deliver scalable, compliant software configurations and data\-driven solutions.
 



 We count on your expertise to prevent defects and represent both technical and end\-user perspectives, fostering a commitment to excellence within the dynamic Insurtech landscape. Your attention to detail, analytical capabilities, and collaborative spirit are crucial for maintaining the highest quality standards in our software solutions.
 



 In this role, you will design and develop custom forms, reports, and database logic that support complex insurance workflows. You will conduct business requirements analysis, perform system configuration and customization, and implement advanced configurations. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, project managers, and client stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive technical solutions.
 








**What will you do in this role?** 



* Business Requirements Gathering \& Analysis
* Facilitate and elicit customer business requirements through workshops, interviews, and discovery sessions.
* Analyze and document functional and non\-functional requirements for complex insurance implementations.
* Develop comprehensive documentation including business rules, use cases, and process flows.
* Translate business needs into technical specifications and system design recommendations.
* System Configuration and Customization
* Participate in technical solution design and configuration for the ConceptOne™ platform.
* Implement configurations and customizations to support identity and access management requirements.
* Perform system configuration and customization based on detailed design documentation and insurance industry best practices.
* Implement relevant aspects of customer requirements through system configuration and advanced customization.
* SQL Development and Database Management
* Develop SQL stored procedures, functions, and queries supporting system configuration, integrations, and business logic.
* Design and implement data sources used for merge documents, form generation, and reporting.
* Manage and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
* Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, and efficient data retrieval.
* Support migration and conversion of database systems and SQL dialects.
* Forms, Reports, and Document Generation
* Design and develop interactive forms and data\-driven document generation solutions.
* Ensure forms support efficient data capture, validation, and document production.
* Build custom reports and data extracts using Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar reporting tools.
* Technical Subject Matter Expert \& Implementation Support
* Serve as a technical and business domain subject matter expert across assigned implementation projects.
* Develop custom integrations with various external applications using API/SDK solutions.
* Identify risks or technical challenges early and propose solutions to project leadership.
* Work closely with project managers, business analysts, architects, and stakeholders to deliver client solutions.
* Quality Assurance \& Testing
* Develop and execute unit tests supporting system configuration and development work.
* Support system testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) during project delivery.
* Review and approve Quality Analyst test cases and test plans against customer requirements.
* Documentation \& Knowledge Management
* Document technical designs, configuration decisions, business requirements, and development standards.
* Maintain current knowledge of industry developments, best practices, and platform enhancements.
* Facilitate end\-user training sessions to ensure smooth transition and adoption of implemented solutions.



  





**What do you need to succeed in this role?** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related technical field.
* 7\+ years of experience in software implementation, database development, business analysis, or technical consulting.
* Strong experience with insurance policy administration systems, with demonstrated expertise in the Property \& Casualty (P\&C) insurance domain.
* Experience with enterprise policy administration platforms such as ConceptOne or similar systems.
* Strong SQL development experience including stored procedures, functions, query optimization, and data transformations.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
* Demonstrated ability to work with relational database systems and complex data models.
* Experience with reporting or forms technologies such as Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar tools.
* Experience with configuration and customization.
* Proficiency in business requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience supporting data integrations or API\-based systems.
* Experience with XML data structures or document generation systems.
* Experience converting SQL dialects or supporting database migrations.
* AINS Certifications or other insurance industry certifications.
* CBAP (Certified Business Analyst Professional) or similar business analysis certification.
* Web Services/APIs and ACORD standards experience.



  





**We offer:** 



* *Family Health Insurance including parents*
* *Life \& Accident Insurance*
* *Maternity/paternity leave*
* *Performance\-based incentives*
* *Referral Bonus program*
* *Exam Fee Reimbursement Policy*
* *Indian festival holidays*
* *5 days working week*
* *Meals facility*
* *Doctor's consultation*

title: Research Analyst - Market & Competitive Intelligence AI Enablement
description:
**Description and Requirements**
**"At BMC trust is not just a word \- it's a way of life!"** 
**Hybrid**
 Description and Requirements
   

  

 BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry\-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
   

  

 Business Unit
   

  

 The Sales Innovation, Growth and Market Acceleration (SIGMA) group partners with the Sales organization to improve seller productivity, strengthen customer engagement, and accelerate growth. This role supports two complementary priorities within SIGMA: AI\-enabled Market \& Competitive Intelligence and the operational execution of Digital Sales programs.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a strategic and execution\-oriented professional for a dual\-role position supporting Market \& Competitive Intelligence AI Enablement (50%) and Digital Sales PMO and Administration (50%).
   

  

 The successful candidate will help transform traditional market and competitive intelligence into an AI\-enabled function through Generative AI, Agentic AI, automation, intelligent research workflows, and Copilot\-based solutions. In parallel, the individual will provide PMO and operational support for Digital Sales programs, ensuring effective governance, coordination, reporting, process administration, and execution management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines hands\-on AI implementation experience with strong program management, stakeholder coordination, business operations, and administrative capabilities. The individual must be comfortable building and scaling AI capabilities while delivering disciplined operational execution across the two workstreams.
   

  

 Indicative role allocation: 50% MCI AI Enablement \| 50% Digital Sales PMO and Administration
   

  

**Primary Roles And Responsibilities**
 Market \& Competitive Intelligence AI Enablement (50%)
   

  

* Lead the adoption and operationalization of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and intelligent automation solutions across the Market \& Competitive Intelligence function.
* Design, build, deploy, administer, and continuously improve AI\-powered intelligence agents that support competitive intelligence, customer intelligence, market research, executive briefings, and knowledge discovery.
* Develop and manage AI\-enabled research workflows that integrate approved internal repositories, external data sources, analyst content, and enterprise knowledge assets.
* Create and optimize prompts, agent instructions, orchestration workflows, grounding strategies, and retrieval approaches to improve the quality, consistency, traceability, and reliability of AI\-generated outputs.
* Establish and apply AI governance, evaluation, risk\-management, responsible\-AI, and quality\-assurance processes to ensure trusted, compliant, source\-backed, and business\-ready intelligence deliverables.
* Partner with MCI and business stakeholders to identify, prioritize, prototype, and implement AI use cases that improve research productivity, insight generation, knowledge access, and decision support.
* Build and maintain AI knowledge repositories, prompt libraries, reusable agent components, templates, documentation, and best practices that enable scalable intelligence operations.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, models, and industry developments to identify opportunities or innovation and continuous improvement within the intelligence function.
* Define, measure, and report AI adoption, usage, output quality, productivity improvements, business outcomes, and operational effectiveness across supported initiatives.
* Develop AI\-driven reporting, automated intelligence updates, executive insight experiences, and self\-service knowledge\-delivery capabilities, while acting as a subject matter expert for Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI agents, prompt engineering, research automation, and intelligent workflow design.


 Digital Sales PMO and Administrative Support (50%)
   

  

* Provide PMO support for Digital Sales initiatives, including planning, scheduling, action tracking, dependency management, governance, and delivery coordination.
* Maintain project plans, roadmaps, milestone trackers, RACI matrices, risk and issue logs, decision records, and success metrics for assigned programs.
* Coordinate meetings and operating cadences, prepare agendas and pre\-reads, document decisions and actions, and follow up with owners to support timely closure.
* Coordinate global Digital Sales stakeholders and cross\-functional teams to maintain alignment, visibility, and execution against agreed priorities.
* Prepare and maintain dashboards, status reports, leadership updates, and other operational communications using accurate and current program data.
* Support process administration, documentation, knowledge repositories, intake and prioritization workflows, access requests, and other recurring operational activities.
* Track program risks, issues, dependencies, and change\-management or adoption activities, escalating items that require leadership attention.
* Support the administration and operational governance of Digital Sales tools and platforms, including user access, vendor coordination, license or usage tracking, adoption reporting, and issue follow\-through.


**Required Experience**
* 5\-8\+ years of relevant experience across AI enablement, business operations, market or competitive intelligence, research, consulting, PMO, program management, or related business functions.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with Generative AI platforms, AI agents, Copilot technologies, prompt engineering, retrieval and grounding approaches, research automation, or intelligent workflow solutions.
* Experience designing, implementing, administering, or supporting AI\-enabled business processes, agents, knowledge repositories, or research solutions.
* Experience establishing or applying AI governance, evaluation, responsible\-AI, quality\-assurance, and adoption practices in a business environment.
* At least 3 years of experience supporting enterprise programs, PMO activities, strategic initiatives, cross\-functional operations, or Digital Sales programs.
* Strong organizational and program\-coordination skills, including experience managing plans, schedules, actions, risks, dependencies, documentation, and recurring governance cadences.
* Experience creating executive reports, dashboards, presentations, operational metrics, and concise business communications.
* Experience coordinating senior stakeholders and global, cross\-functional teams across Sales, Digital Sales, Product Management, Pre\-Sales, Marketing, Strategy, or Technology functions.
* Ability to balance AI initiatives and operational workstreams, work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver consistently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 productivity and collaboration tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Strong attention to detail, data accuracy, confidentiality, and follow\-through.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification.
* PMP, Agile, Scrum, or related program\-management certification.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, Power BI, or similar AI, automation, and analytics platforms.

title: AI Product Lead
description:
**Role Description**
 Role Summary
   

  

 The Product Lead will own the CME\-facing product definition and evolution of AI\-led media solutions, while the underlying platform development and engineering are owned by the Blueverse product and technology teams. The role sits at the intersection of media clients, CME business and consulting teams, AI/model partners, and Blueverse.
   

  

 This is a client\-facing, AI\-intensive product role rather than a platform engineering ownership role. The incumbent will discover enterprise media problems, map client workflows, research relevant AI approaches, define reusable product requirements and use cases, and work with Blueverse to translate them into scalable platform capabilities.
   

  

 CME Product Mandate
   

  

 Own the CME AI product and use\-case strategy across media workflows such as Video Intelligence, Ad tech use cases, Content Operations, QoE and emerging agentic applications.
   

  

* Identify which client problems should become reusable CME capabilities, which should remain configurable client extensions, and which should be treated as one\-off services.
* Maintain the CME product/use\-case roadmap and prioritize opportunities based on client value, repeatability, AI feasibility, commercial relevance and alignment with Blueverse platform capabilities.
* Represent the CME AI product point of view in client, executive, GTM, consulting and Blueverse roadmap discussions.


 Client Discovery \& Workflow Integration
   

  

* Lead product discovery with media clients to understand the business problem, users, current operating workflow, systems, data, pain points, controls and desired business outcome.
* Map how AI capabilities fit into existing client environments such as MAM/CMS, content supply\-chain systems, data platforms, workflow tools and downstream distribution or monetization systems.
* Convert discoveries into clear product requirements: user journeys, workflow diagrams, business rules, data/metadata needs, integration requirements, acceptance criteria and human\-review checkpoints.
* Identify where AI should assist, automate, recommend or remain human\-controlled; avoid applying agentic AI where deterministic workflow or conventional automation is more appropriate.
* Own the client\-facing scope and product narrative for pilots/POCs, including what is standard, configurable and custom, and feed validated requirements back into the CME and Blueverse roadmaps.
* Lead product demonstrations and solution workshops, explaining the business workflow, AI reasoning and value in language appropriate for both senior management and client technology teams.


 AI Research, Model \& Partner Responsibilities
   

  

* Act as the CME AI subject\-matter lead with strong working knowledge of multimodal/video AI, computer vision, speech and language AI, LLMs, embeddings, semantic retrieval, RAG, recommendation systems and agentic workflow patterns.
* Continuously research emerging models, media\-AI products, hyperscaler capabilities and competitive platforms; translate relevant developments into actionable CME product opportunities rather than research for its own sake.
* Evaluate specialist AI/model partners for use\-case fit, quality, cost, latency, deployment constraints, security, extensibility, roadmap alignment and vendor lock\-in.
* Work with model partners on workflow fit, commercial constructs, model access and enterprise deployment requirements; recommend build, Blueverse\-enable, partner or hybrid approaches.
* Define how AI outputs should become usable workflow outcomes through metadata normalization, business rules, confidence thresholds, ranking, human review and feedback loops.
* Partner with Data Scientists/AI SMEs where needed to define evaluation approach, test datasets, failure analysis and


 model\-selection criteria for specific CME use cases.
   

  

 Blueverse Product \& Technology Interface
   

  

* Act as the primary CME product bridge into the Blueverse product and technology organization.
* Translate validated CME client requirements into structured product inputs for Blueverse, including workflow needs,


 integration patterns, AI/model requirements, governance needs and reusable platform capabilities.
   

  

* Work jointly with Blueverse on APIs, adapters, workflow orchestration, model onboarding and client integration patterns


 required to make CME solutions repeatable across accounts.
   

  

* Maintain clear ownership boundaries: CME Product Lead owns the media problem, use case, workflow, requirements and


 client outcome; Blueverse owns how the horizontal platform is engineered and shipped.
   

  

**Preferred Experience \& Qualifications**
* 8–9 years of experience across product management, enterprise AI/data products, B2B SaaS, workflow platforms or


 technology consulting with meaningful client\-facing product ownership.
   

  

* Strong experience translating ambiguous enterprise problems into product requirements, workflows, pilots and reusable


 capabilities.
   

  

* Practical AI product knowledge across multimodal/video AI, LLMs, RAG, search, speech/language AI, model evaluation


 and agentic workflows.
   

  

* Strong understanding of enterprise integration fundamentals including APIs, data/metadata models, event flows, cloud


 services, security, privacy and deployment constraints.
   

  

* Experience evaluating and working with third\-party AI/model providers, hyperscalers or technology partners and making


 pragmatic build\-versus\-partner decisions.
   

  

* Excellent client discovery, problem structuring, executive presentation, product storytelling, stakeholder management and


 cross\-functional influencing skills.
   

  

* Media \& Entertainment domain exposure, particularly content supply chain, video intelligence, localization, streaming or


 media operations, is strongly preferred.
   

  

* Ability to work independently.

title: Delivery Solutions Architect
description:
CSQ427R264
   

  

 At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilising the the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
   

  

 As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey. You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform in your customers. You will also help ensure customer success by increasing focus and technical accountability to our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate usage on Databricks workloads that they have already selected, helping them maximise the value they get of our platform and the return on investment.
   

  

 This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestration of other focused/ specialised teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon. This is in parallel to being technical, with expectations being that you become the post\-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. This requires you to use your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate at all levels with an organisation. You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization.
   

  

**The Impact You Will Have** 
  

  

* Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritised customers
* Lead the post\-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
* Be the accountable technical leader assigned to specific use cases and customer(s) across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, success, go\-live and healthy consumption of the workloads where the customer has made the decision to consume Databricks
* Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, oftentimes services multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
* Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services and Support resources, along with escalating to expert level technical experts to build the right tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise
* Create, own and execute a point\-of\-view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
* Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews and upgrade needs
* Develop an execution plan that covers all activities of all customer\-facing technical roles and teams to cover the below work streams:
+ Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production
+ Enablement / user growth plan
+ Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision)
+ Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning \& optimization)
+ Executive and operational governance

* Provide internal and external updates \- KPI reporting on the status of usage and customer health, covering investment status, important risks, product adoption and use case progression \- to your Technical GM


**What We Look For**
* 10\+ years of experience where you have been accountable for technical project / program delivery within the domain of Data and AI and where you can contribute to technical debate and design choices with customers
* Programming experience in Python, SQL or Scala
* Experience in a customer\-facing pre\-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role
* Understanding of solution architecture related distributed data systems
* Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables
* Technical program, or project management including account, stakeholder and resource management accountability
* Experience resolving complex and important escalation with senior customer executives
* Experience conducting open\-ended discovery workshops, creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis and managing delivery of complex programmes/projects
* Track record of overachievement against quota, Goals or similar objective targets
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience
* Can travel up to 30% when needed


**About Databricks**
 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
   

  

**Benefits**

 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
 Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
   

  

 Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
   

  

**Job Overview**
**Senior Product Manager – Risk Platform**
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to help define and scale a modern risk and compliance platform for a global payments business. The platform will serve as the common foundation for embedding risk and compliance into payment journeys consistently, intelligently, and at scale.
   

  

 This is a platform product role: the successful candidate will think beyond individual workflows and design reusable services, APIs, and configuration models that can be adopted by multiple products and business lines. The role requires strong systems thinking, technical fluency, and the ability to balance regulatory obligations, operational efficiency, and user experience.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for reusable risk and compliance platform capabilities across products and regions.
* Turn risk, compliance, operational, and customer needs into clear product requirements and delivery plans.
* Shape core platform capabilities such as policy evaluation, decision orchestration, restrictions, and verification journeys.
* Design capabilities that can be consumed through standardized APIs, hosted experiences, and embedded user flows.
* Build shared foundations such as canonical data models, action and decision models, and reusable workflow patterns.
* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, UX, and Compliance teams to deliver scalable and explainable solutions.
* Use data and stakeholder feedback to identify gaps, prioritize trade\-offs, and measure platform impact.
* Balance self\-service adoption with governance, reliability, and regulatory readiness.
* Communicate product direction, key decisions, and delivery progress to senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* 5\+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in platform, fintech, payments, or regulated products.
* Experience with risk, compliance, KYC/KYB, or AML workflows.
* Experience with API\-first platforms, workflow orchestration, decisioning systems, or third\-party integrations.
* Strong track record defining strategy, building roadmaps, and driving cross\-functional execution.
* Platform mindset, with the ability to design reusable capabilities, APIs, workflows, and shared data models.
* Strong systems thinking, with the ability to simplify complex processes across products, systems, and teams.
* Good understanding of UX, workflows, business processes, and operational needs.
* Technical fluency across APIs, integrations, data models, and system design.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills across senior and cross\-functional audiences.
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity, structuring complex problems, and driving alignment across competing priorities.
